description: This file defines a validation rule class EmployeeDataGroupReadPermissionRule used in the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It checks if a user has permission to read a specific data group based on their roles and permissions.

classes.name: EmployeeDataGroupReadPermissionRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that verifies if a user has read permission for a specific data group within the attendance module.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the rule with the name of the data group to check permissions for.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs the permission check and returns true if the user has read access; otherwise throws a ForbiddenException.
